title: Exploring estrogen synthesis and metabolism related markers and immune dynamics in osteoporosis-insights from single-cell RNA sequencing and Mendelian randomization.
authors: Hao, Xiaoyun; Sun, Gang; Wang, Yu; Xu, Fei; Lan, Lizhen
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞RNA测序和孟德尔随机化探索骨质疏松中雌激素代谢相关标志物，属于纯表达与临床关联分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoporosis (OP) is characterized by decreased bone mineral density and an increased fracture risk, often due to declining sex hormone levels that weaken bone strength. This study aims to explore estrogen related markers in OP to improve diagnosis and treatment. METHODS: Differentially expressed estrogen synthesis and metabolism-related genes (DE-ERGs) were identified through differential expression analysis and intersected with estrogen synthesis and metabolism-related genes (ERGs). Machine learning techniques and expression analysis were used to identify markers, followed by the construction of nomogram. Mendelian Randomization (MR) analysis was then employed to investigate the causal relationship between markers and OP. Finally, the expression of markers was validated by quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) and western blot analyses. RESULTS: CCND1, SCGB1A1, and DDIT4 were identified as markers for OP, with DDIT4 (Odds Ratio (OR) = 1.267; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 1.054-1.523; P = 0.0012) serving as a risk factor. A nomogram was developed with a calibration curve slope near 1, and an area under the curve (AUC) value of 0.9, indicating strong predictive ability. The qRT-PCR and western blot analyses confirmed that DDIT4 was up-regulated and CCND1 was down-regulated in OP group. CONCLUSION: This study highlighted CCND1, DDIT4, and SCGB1A1 as markers for OP, supporting their involvement in disease progression and offering a foundation for targeted therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨质疏松症（OP）以骨密度降低和骨折风险增加为特征，通常由性激素水平下降导致骨强度减弱所致。本研究旨在探索OP中雌激素相关标志物，以改善诊断和治疗。方法：通过差异表达分析鉴定雌激素合成与代谢相关基因中的差异表达基因（DE-ERGs），并与雌激素合成与代谢相关基因（ERGs）取交集。利用机器学习技术和表达分析识别标志物，随后构建列线图。采用孟德尔随机化（MR）分析探究标志物与OP之间的因果关系。最后，通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）和蛋白质印迹分析验证标志物的表达。结果：CCND1、SCGB1A1和DDIT4被确定为OP的标志物，其中DDIT4（比值比（OR）= 1.267；95%置信区间（CI）：1.054-1.523；P = 0.0012）作为风险因素。构建的列线图校准曲线斜率接近1，曲线下面积（AUC）值为0.9，表明预测能力较强。qRT-PCR和蛋白质印迹分析证实，OP组中DDIT4表达上调，CCND1表达下调。结论：本研究强调CCND1、DDIT4和SCGB1A1作为OP的标志物，支持其在疾病进展中的作用，并为靶向治疗策略提供了基础。
